/-- Boolean check that the values of `seq` at the given indices are strictly increasing. -/
def valsIncB (seq : List Int) : List Nat → Bool
  | [] => true
  | a :: t => t.all (fun b => decide (seq.getD a 0 < seq.getD b 0)) && valsIncB seq t

/-- Maximum of a list of naturals (0 for the empty list). -/
def maxOf : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | a :: t => if maxOf t ≤ a then a else maxOf t

/-- The length of the longest increasing subsequence, computed by brute force. -/
def lisVal (seq : List Int) : Nat :=
  maxOf ((((List.range seq.length).sublists).filter (valsIncB seq)).map List.length)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

def longest_increasing_subsequence (seq : List Int)
    (h_precond : longest_increasing_subsequence_precond seq) : Nat :=

  -- !benchmark @end code

/-- `inc_nat l` states that the list `l` of natural numbers is strictly increasing. -/
def inc_nat (l : List Nat) : Prop :=

  ∀ i j, i < j → i < indices.length → j < indices.length →
    seq.getD (indices.getD i 0) 0 < seq.getD (indices.getD j 0) 0

/-- `is_valid_is seq indices` bundles the three necessary conditions for a list of indices
    to represent a valid increasing subsequence of `seq`. -/

  inc_nat indices ∧
  (∀ i, i ∈ indices → i < seq.length) ∧
  inc_vals seq indices

@[reducible, simp]
def longest_increasing_subsequence_postcond
    (seq : List Int) (result : Nat)
    (h_precond : longest_increasing_subsequence_precond seq) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ sub : List Nat, is_valid_is seq sub → sub.length ≤ result) ∧
  (∃ sub : List Nat, is_valid_is seq sub ∧ sub.length = result)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

theorem lis_getD_zero {α : Type} (a : α) (t : List α) (d : α) : (a :: t).getD 0 d = a := by
  first
  | rfl
  | simp

theorem lis_getD_succ {α : Type} (a : α) (t : List α) (d : α) (k : Nat) :
    (a :: t).getD (k + 1) d = t.getD k d := by
  first
  | rfl
  | simp

theorem lis_getD_mem {α : Type} (d : α) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (i : Nat), i < l.length → l.getD i d ∈ l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro i h; simp at h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro i h
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      rw [lis_getD_zero]
      simp
    | succ k =>
      have hk : k < t.length := by
        simp only [List.length_cons] at h; omega
      rw [lis_getD_succ]
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih k hk)

theorem lis_exists_getD {α : Type} (d : α) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (b : α), b ∈ l → ∃ k, k < l.length ∧ l.getD k d = b := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro b hb; simp at hb
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro b hb
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hb with rfl | h
    · exact ⟨0, by simp, by rw [lis_getD_zero]⟩
    · obtain ⟨k, hk, hkb⟩ := ih b h
      refine ⟨k + 1, by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega, ?_⟩
      rw [lis_getD_succ]
      exact hkb

    ∀ (l : List α), l.Pairwise R ↔
      ∀ i j, i < j → j < l.length → R (l.getD i d) (l.getD j d) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    constructor
    · intro _ i j _ hj; simp at hj
    · intro _; exact List.Pairwise.nil
  | cons a t ih =>
    constructor
    · intro h i j hij hj
      rcases List.pairwise_cons.mp h with ⟨ha, ht⟩
      cases j with
      | zero => omega
      | succ k =>
        have hk : k < t.length := by
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hj; omega
        cases i with
        | zero =>
          rw [lis_getD_zero, lis_getD_succ]
          exact ha _ (lis_getD_mem d t k hk)
        | succ m =>
          rw [lis_getD_succ, lis_getD_succ]
          exact (ih.mp ht) m k (by omega) hk
    · intro h
      refine List.pairwise_cons.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro b hb
        obtain ⟨k, hk, hkb⟩ := lis_exists_getD d t b hb
        have h2 := h 0 (k + 1) (by omega) (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
        rw [lis_getD_zero, lis_getD_succ, hkb] at h2
        exact h2
      · refine ih.mpr ?_
        intro i j hij hj
        have h2 := h (i + 1) (j + 1) (by omega) (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
        rw [lis_getD_succ, lis_getD_succ] at h2
        exact h2

  rw [lis_pairwise_iff_getD (fun a b : Nat => a < b) 0 l]

  · intro h i j hij hj

  · intro h i j hij _ hj
    exact h i j hij hj

    inc_vals seq l ↔ l.Pairwise (fun a b => seq.getD a 0 < seq.getD b 0) := by
  rw [lis_pairwise_iff_getD (fun a b : Nat => seq.getD a 0 < seq.getD b 0) 0 l]

  · intro h i j hij hj
    exact h i j hij (by omega) hj
  · intro h i j hij _ hj

  induction l with
  | nil => simp [valsIncB]
  | cons a t ih =>

    · intro h

      exact List.pairwise_cons.mpr ⟨h.1, ih.mp h.2⟩
    · intro h
      rcases List.pairwise_cons.mp h with ⟨ha, ht⟩
      simp only [valsIncB, Bool.and_eq_true, List.all_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
      exact ⟨ha, ih.mpr ht⟩

theorem maxOf_ge : ∀ (L : List Nat) (x : Nat), x ∈ L → x ≤ maxOf L := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil => intro x hx; simp at hx
  | cons a t ih =>

    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | h
    · simp only [maxOf]

    · have h2 := ih x h
      simp only [maxOf]
      split <;> omega

theorem maxOf_mem : ∀ (L : List Nat), maxOf L = 0 ∨ maxOf L ∈ L := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil => left; rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    simp only [maxOf]
    by_cases hc : maxOf t ≤ a
    · rw [if_pos hc]
      right
      simp
    · rw [if_neg hc]
      rcases ih with h0 | hm
      · left; exact h0
      · right; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm

theorem lis_pairwise_lt_range : ∀ (n : Nat), (List.range n).Pairwise (· < ·) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [List.range_succ, List.pairwise_append]
    refine ⟨ih, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp
    · intro x hx y hy
      simp at hx hy
      omega

theorem lis_pairwise_of_sublist {α : Type} {R : α → α → Prop} :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List α}, l₁.Sublist l₂ → l₂.Pairwise R → l₁.Pairwise R := by
  intro l₁ l₂ h
  induction h with
  | slnil => intro _; exact List.Pairwise.nil
  | cons a h ih => intro hp; exact ih (List.pairwise_cons.mp hp).2
  | cons₂ a h ih =>
    intro hp
    rcases List.pairwise_cons.mp hp with ⟨ha, ht⟩
    exact List.pairwise_cons.mpr ⟨fun b hb => ha b (h.subset hb), ih ht⟩

    l.Pairwise (· < ·) → (∀ x ∈ l, x < n) → l.Sublist (List.range n) := by
  intro n

  | zero =>
    intro l hp hb
    cases l with
    | nil => exact List.nil_sublist _
    | cons a t => exact absurd (hb a (by simp)) (by omega)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro l hp hb
    by_cases hn : n ∈ l
    · obtain ⟨s, t, rfl⟩ := List.append_of_mem hn
      have hsplit := List.pairwise_append.mp hp

        | nil => rfl
        | cons b t' =>

          have hnt : ∀ x ∈ (b :: t'), n < x := (List.pairwise_cons.mp hsplit.2.1).1
          have h1 : n < b := hnt b (by simp)
          have h2 : b < n + 1 := hb b (by simp)
          omega
      subst ht
      rw [List.range_succ]
      refine List.Sublist.append (ih s hsplit.1 ?_) (List.Sublist.refl [n])
      intro x hx
      exact hsplit.2.2 x hx n (by simp)
    · have hb' : ∀ x ∈ l, x < n := by
        intro x hx
        have h1 : x < n + 1 := hb x hx
        have h2 : x ≠ n := by rintro rfl; exact hn hx
        omega
      have h3 := ih l hp hb'
      have h5 : (List.range n).Sublist (List.range n ++ [n]) := by
        have h4 : ((List.range n) ++ ([] : List Nat)).Sublist ((List.range n) ++ [n]) :=
          List.Sublist.append (List.Sublist.refl _) (List.nil_sublist _)
        rwa [List.append_nil] at h4
      rw [List.range_succ]
      exact h3.trans h5

    (∀ sub : List Nat, is_valid_is seq sub → sub.length ≤ lisVal seq) ∧
    (∃ sub : List Nat, is_valid_is seq sub ∧ sub.length = lisVal seq) := by

    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hsub

      List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hmem, hb⟩
    have hmap : sub.length ∈

      with h0 | hm

        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro i j _ hi _; simp at hi
        · intro i hi; simp at hi
        · intro i j _ hi _; simp at hi

    · obtain ⟨l, hl, hlen⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hm
      obtain ⟨hmem, hb⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hl
